:::{#def-sensitivity}
#### Sensitivity

The **sensitivity** of a diagnostic test is the probability
that the test is positive ($+$),
given that the person tested has the disease ($D$) [@wikipedia_sensitivity_and_specificity]:

$$\text{sensitivity} \eqdef \Pr(+ \mid D)$$ {#eq-sensitivity}

Source: @wikipedia_sensitivity_and_specificity.
:::
